description.value: Procter Village Cafe is a small community cafe located in Procter, a quiet settlement on the west arm of Kootenay Lake in BC's Kootenays region. Sitting along a scenic stretch of road popular with touring cyclists, it appears to serve as a local gathering spot for this tight-knit rural community. Cyclists travelling the Kootenay Lake corridor may find it a convenient stop in an otherwise sparsely serviced area.
